npc/the-keeper.doing: standing on the walk beside a barred door, keeping a survey nobody has asked her for

happening.text: The surveyor is put down in the hub, on a floor whose colour is the only thing naming it.
The surveyor crosses the seam the plan cut into the hub's east wall.

objectives.hint: The hub's east wall is cut through once, and the doorway is framed in a darker block than the wall around it.
objectives.title: Cross the seam

happening.text: The surveyor climbs a run nobody drew and comes out on the upper walk.

objectives.hint: The gallery's north wall opens at the top of a run of pale steps.
objectives.title: Climb out of the gallery

npc/the-keeper.doing: deciding, out loud and without hurrying, to hand over the only copy she has

happening.subject: npc/the-keeper
happening.text: The keeper gives up the survey.

happening.subject: npc/the-keeper
happening.text: The keeper says what is behind the door and why she has kept it shut.
The surveyor reads the plan of the place they are standing in.

objectives.hint: Past the door in the walk's north wall, on the black floor.
objectives.title: Read the survey

happening.subject: anchor/seam-the-bar
happening.text: The bar comes off the vault door.

npc/the-keeper.doing: correcting herself, too late, about how old the survey is

happening.text: The circuit closes: the surveyor comes back into the hub through the wall above it.
The surveyor walks out of the vault onto the ledge over the hub.

objectives.hint: West out of the vault, through the arch, onto the ledge.
objectives.title: Walk the lip

happening.text: The surveyor drops five blocks onto the floor they started on.

objectives.hint: The ledge ends over the hub. Step off, and walk to the middle of the floor you started on.
objectives.title: Take the hole home

happening.text: The circuit is walked, and the survey of it is out of date.

effects.text: Barred. It is not the door that decides.
